chapter.heading: Psalm 23The Lord, the Psalmist’s Shepherd.A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
The Lord
is my Shepherd [to feed, to guide and to shield me], [Ezek 34:11-31]I shall not want.

He lets
me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside the still and quiet waters. [Rev 7:17]

He refreshes
and restores my soul (life); He leads me in the paths of righteousnessfor His name’s sake.

¶Even though
I walk through the [sunless] valley of the shadow of death, I fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod [to protect] and Your staff [to guide], they comfort and console me.

You prepare
a table before me in the presence of my enemies.You have anointed and refreshed my head with oil; My cup overflows.

Surely goodness
and mercy and unfailing love shall follow me all the days of my life, And I shall dwell forever [throughout all my days] in the house and in the presence of the Lord.
